# CONSULAR SERVICES The consular desk serves citizens of the Union on this colony and foreign nationals with lawful business with the Union. Bring your papers. Bring all of them.
## FOR CITIZENS OF THE UNION - [bold]Registration[/bold]: every citizen on this colony must register with the mission within one shift of arrival, whether by contract, by transfer or by accident. - [bold]Lost documents[/bold]: identity papers lost or confiscated by local authorities will be reissued after an interview. - [bold]Detention[/bold]: a citizen held by the colony Marshal, the Colonial Marines or a corporate security force has the right to see a representative of the mission. Say nothing until we arrive. - [bold]Repatriation[/bold]: passage to a Union world is arranged when a Union vessel is in the system. Space is limited. Priority goes to the injured and to families. - [bold]Remittances[/bold]: wages sent home travel in the diplomatic pouch, free of corporate fees.
## FOR FOREIGN NATIONALS - [bold]Entry permits[/bold] for Union territory are issued on Earth only. The mission cannot sell you a permit, and anyone who offers one is a criminal. - [bold]Trade enquiries[/bold] are forwarded to the commercial attache. Expect a long wait and a short answer. - [bold]Requests for asylum[/bold] are heard in person, in private, and are never discussed on this network.
## HOURS The desk is open whenever the Ambassador is present. In an emergency, any member of the mission staff will take your name.
[color=#FF7A5C][bold]Notice:[/bold][/color] the mission does not provide medical care, weapons, rations or transport to the landing field. Do not ask.
